sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to menu

params.name: process
params.description: Process number designating another process's menu bar; only meaningful when menu is a menu number.

overloads.semanticRole: Get the name of the 4D project method attached to a menu item.

constraints: If menu is a menu reference (MenuRef), the process parameter is unnecessary and is ignored if passed; if menu is a menu number, the command applies to the main menu bar of the process designated by process (or the current process if omitted).
Returns an empty string if no 4D project method is associated with the menu item.
